final: WITH category_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as cat_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(cat_avg) as overall_average FROM category_avgs WHERE cat_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT ca.production_type_code, ca.cat_avg, ca.cat_avg - oa.overall_average as difference FROM category_avgs ca CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ca.cat_avg > oa.overall_average ORDER BY CASE WHEN ca.cat_avg - oa.overall_average IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ca.cat_avg - oa.overall_average DESC LIMIT 10
